original: (4.6.2.4.k) viśvataścakṣur uta viśvatomukho viśvatohasta uta viśvataspāt / sam bāhubhyāṃ namati sam patatrair dyāvāpṛthivī janayan deva ekaḥ //
analyzed: viśvatas cakṣuḥ uta viśvatomukhaḥ viśvatohastaḥ uta viśvataspād sam bāhubhyām namati sam patatraiḥ dyāvāpṛthivī janayan devaḥ ekaḥ

original: (4.6.2.4ḷ) kiṁ svid āsīd adhiṣṭhānam ārambhaṇaṃ katamat svit kim āsīt / yadī bhūmiṃ janayan //(4.6.2.5) viśvakarmā vi dyām aurṇon mahinā viśvacakṣāḥ //
analyzed: kiṁ svid āsīt adhiṣṭhānam ārambhaṇam katamat svid kim āsīt yadi bhūmim janayan viśvakarmā vi dyām aurṇot mahinā viśva cakṣāḥ

original: (4.6.2.5ṃ) kiṁ svid vanaṃ ka u sa vṛkṣa āsīd yato dyāvāpṛthivī niṣṭatakṣuḥ / manīṣiṇo manasā pṛchated u tad yad adhyatiṣṭhad bhuvanāni dhārayan //
analyzed: kim svid vanam kaḥ u sa vṛkṣaḥ āsīt yatas dyāvāpṛthivī niṣṭatakṣuḥ manīṣiṇaḥ manasā pṛcchata id u tat yat adhyatiṣṭhat bhuvanāni dhārayan

original: (4.6.2.5ṇ) yā te dhāmāni paramāṇi yāvamā yā madhyamā viśvakarmann utemā / śikṣā sakhibhyo haviṣi svadhāvaḥ svayaṃ yajasva tanuvaṃ juṣāṇaḥ //
analyzed: yā te dhāmāni paramāṇi yā avamā yā madhyamā viśvakarman uta imā śikṣa sakhibhyaḥ haviṣi svadhāvas svayam yajasva tanuvam juṣāṇaḥ

original: (4.6.2.5.o) vācas patiṃ viśvakarmāṇam ūtaye //(4.6.2.6) manoyujaṃ vāje adyā huvema / sa no nediṣṭhā havanāni joṣate viśvaśambhūr avase sādhukarmā //
analyzed: u vācaḥ patim viśvakarmāṇam ūtaye manaḥ yujam vāje adya huvema sa naḥ nediṣṭhā havanāni joṣate viśva śambhūḥ avase sādhu karmā

original: (4.6.2.6.p) viśvakarman haviṣā vāvṛdhānaḥ svayaṃ yajasva tanuvaṃ juṣāṇaḥ / muhyantv anye abhitaḥ sapatnā ihāsmākam maghavā sūrir astu //
analyzed: viśvakarman haviṣā vāvṛdhānaḥ svayam yajasva tanuvam juṣāṇaḥ muhyantu anye abhitas sapatnāḥ iha asmākam maghavā sūriḥ astu

original: (4.6.2.6.q) viśvakarman haviṣā vardhanena trātāram indram akṛṇor avadhyam / tasmai viśaḥ sam anamanta pūrvīr ayam ugro vihavyo yathāsat //
analyzed: viśvakarman haviṣā vardhanena trātāram indram akṛṇoḥ avadhyam tasmai viśaḥ sam anamanta pūrvīḥ ayam ugraḥ vihavyaḥ yathā asat

original: (4.6.2.6ṛ) samudrāya vayunāya sindhūnām pataye namaḥ / nadīnāṁ sarvāsām pitre juhutā viśvakarmaṇe viśvāhāmartyaṁ haviḥ //
analyzed: samudrāya vayunāya sindhūnām pataye namaḥ nadīnām sarvāsām pitre juhutā viśvakarmaṇe viśvāhā amartyaṁ haviḥ

original: (4.6.3.1.a) ud enam uttarāṃ nayāgne ghṛtenāhuta / rāyas poṣeṇa saṁ sṛja prajayā ca dhanena ca //
analyzed: ud enam uttarām naya agne ghṛtena āhuta rāyaḥ poṣeṇa saṁ sṛja prajayā ca dhanena ca

original: (4.6.3.1.b) indremam pratarāṃ kṛdhi sajātānām asad vaśī / sam enaṃ varcasā sṛja devebhyo bhāgadhā asat //
analyzed: indra imam pratarām kṛdhi sajātānām asat vaśī sam enam varcasā sṛja devebhyaḥ bhāgadhāḥ asat

original: (4.6.3.1.c) yasya kurmo havir gṛhe tam agne vardhayā tvam / tasmai devā adhi bravann ayaṃ ca brahmaṇas patiḥ //
analyzed: yasya kurmaḥ haviḥ gṛhe tam agne vardhaya tvam tasmai devāḥ adhi bravan ayam ca brahmaṇas patiḥ

original: (4.6.3.1ḍ) ud u tvā viśve devāḥ //(4.6.3.2) agne bharantu cittibhiḥ / sa no bhava śivatamaḥ supratīko vibhāvasuḥ //
analyzed: ud u tvā viśve devāḥ agne bharantu cittibhiḥ sa naḥ bhava śivatamaḥ su pratīkaḥ vibhāvasuḥ

original: (4.6.3.2.e) pañca diśo daivīr yajñam avantu devīr apāmatiṃ durmatim bādhamānāḥ / rāyas poṣe yajñapatim ābhajantīḥ //
analyzed: pañca diśaḥ daivīḥ yajñam avantu devīḥ apa amatim durmatim bādhamānāḥ rāyaḥ poṣe yajñapatim ābhajantīḥ

original: (4.6.3.2.f) rāyas poṣe adhi yajño asthāt samiddhe agnāv adhi māmahānaḥ / ukthapattra īḍyo gṛbhītas taptaṃ gharmam parigṛhyāyajanta //
analyzed: rāyaḥ poṣe adhi yajñaḥ asthāt samiddhe agnau adhi māmahānaḥ uktha pattraḥ īḍyaḥ gṛbhītaḥ taptam gharmam parigṛhya ayajanta

original: (4.6.3.2.g) ūrjā yad yajñam aśamanta devā daivyāya dhartre joṣṭre / devaśrīḥ śrīmaṇāḥ śatapayāḥ //(4.6.3.3) parigṛhya devā yajñam āyan //
analyzed: ūrjā yat yajñam aśamanta devāḥ daivyāya dhartre joṣṭre deva śrīḥ śrīmaṇāḥ śatapayāḥ parigṛhya devāḥ yajñam āyan

original: (4.6.3.3ḥ) sūryaraśmir harikeśaḥ purastāt savitā jyotir ud ayāṁ ajasram / tasya pūṣā prasavaṃ yāti devaḥ sampaśyan viśvā bhuvanāni gopāḥ //
analyzed: sūrya raśmiḥ hari keśaḥ purastāt savitā jyotiḥ ud ayāṁ ajasram tasya pūṣā prasavam yāti devaḥ sampaśyan viśvā bhuvanāni gopāḥ

original: (4.6.3.3.i) devā devebhyo adhvaryanto asthur vītaṁ śamitre śamitā yajadhyai / turīyo yajño yatra havyam eti tataḥ pāvakā aśiṣo no juṣantām //
analyzed: devāḥ devebhyaḥ adhvaryantaḥ asthuḥ vītaṁ śamitre śamitā yajadhyai turīyaḥ yajñaḥ yatra havyam eti tatas pāvakāḥ aśiṣaḥ naḥ juṣantām

original: (4.6.3.3.k) vimāna eṣa divo madhya āsta āpaprivān rodasī antarikṣam / sa viśvācīr abhi //(4.6.3.4) caṣṭe ghṛtācīr antarā pūrvam aparaṃ ca ketum //
analyzed: vimānaḥ eṣa divaḥ madhye āste āpaprivān rodasī antarikṣam sa viśvācīḥ abhi caṣṭe ghṛtācīḥ antarā pūrvam aparam ca ketum

original: (4.6.3.4ḷ) ukṣā samudro aruṇaḥ suparṇaḥ pūrvasya yonim pitur ā viveśa / madhye divo nihitaḥ pṛśnir aśmā vi cakrame rajasaḥ pāty antau //
analyzed: ukṣā samudraḥ aruṇaḥ suparṇaḥ pūrvasya yonim pituḥ ā viveśa madhye divaḥ nihitaḥ pṛśniḥ aśmā vi cakrame rajasaḥ pāti antau

original: (4.6.3.4ṃ) indraṃ viśvā avīvṛdhant samudravyacasaṃ giraḥ / rathītamaṁ rathīnāṃ vājānāṁ satpatim patim //
analyzed: indram viśvāḥ avīvṛdhan samudra vyacasam giraḥ rathītamaṁ rathīnām vājānām satpatim patim

analyzed: sumna hūḥ yajñaḥ devāṁ ā ca vakṣat yakṣat agniḥ devaḥ devāṁ ā ca vakṣat

original: (4.6.3.4.o) vājasya mā prasavenodgrābheṇod agrabhīt / athā sapatnāṁ indro me nigrābheṇādharāṁ akaḥ //
analyzed: u vājasya mā prasavena udgrābheṇa ud agrabhīt atha sapatnāṁ indraḥ me nigrābheṇa adharāṁ akaḥ

original: (4.6.3.4.p) udgrābhaṃ ca nigrābhaṃ ca brahma devā avīvṛdhan / athā sapatnān indrāgnī me viṣūcīnān vy asyatām //
analyzed: udgrābham ca nigrābham ca brahma devāḥ avīvṛdhan atha sapatnān indra agnī me viṣūcīnān vi asyatām

original: (4.6.4.1.a) āśuḥ śiśāno vṛṣabho na yudhmo ghanāghanaḥ kṣobhaṇaś carṣaṇīnām / saṃkrandano 'nimiṣa ekavīraḥ śataṁ senā ajayat sākam indraḥ //
analyzed: āśuḥ śiśānaḥ vṛṣabhaḥ na yudhmaḥ ghanāghanaḥ kṣobhaṇaḥ carṣaṇīnām saṃkrandanaḥ nimiṣaḥ eka vīraḥ śatam senāḥ ajayat sākam indraḥ

original: (4.6.4.1.b) saṃkrandanenānimiṣeṇa jiṣṇunā yutkāreṇa duścyavanena dhṛṣṇunā / tad indreṇa jayata tat sahadhvaṃ yudho nara iṣuhastena vṛṣṇā //
analyzed: saṃkrandanena animiṣeṇa jiṣṇunā yutkāreṇa duścyavanena dhṛṣṇunā tat indreṇa jayata tat sahadhvam yudhaḥ naraḥ iṣu hastena vṛṣṇā

original: (4.6.4.1.c) sa iṣuhastaiḥ sa niṣaṅgibhir vāśī saṁsraṣṭā sa yudha indro gaṇena / saṁsṛṣṭajit somapā bāhuśardhy ūrdhvadhanvā pratihitābhir astā //
analyzed: saḥ iṣu hastaiḥ sa niṣaṅgibhiḥ vāśī saṁsraṣṭā sa yudhaḥ indraḥ gaṇena saṃsṛṣṭa jit soma pāḥ bāhuśardhī ūrdhva dhanvā pratihitābhiḥ astā

original: (4.6.4.1ḍ) bṛhaspate pari dīya //(4.6.4.2) rathena rakṣohāmitrāṁ apabādhamānaḥ / prabhañjant senāḥ pramṛṇo yudhā jayann asmākam edhy avitā rathānām //
analyzed: bṛhaspate pari dīya 4642 rathena rakṣaḥ hā amitrāṁ apabādhamānaḥ prabhañjan senāḥ pramṛṇaḥ yudhā jayan asmākam edhi avitā rathānām

original: (4.6.4.2.e) gotrabhidaṃ govidaṃ vajrabāhuṃ jayantam ajma pramṛṇantam ojasā / imaṁ sajātā anu vīrayadhvam indraṁ sakhāyo 'nu saṁ rabhadhvam //
analyzed: gotrabhidam go vidam vajra bāhum jayantam ajma pramṛṇantam ojasā iman sajātāḥ anu vīrayadhvam indram sakhāyaḥ nu sam rabhadhvam

original: (4.6.4.2.f) balavijñāya sthaviraḥ pravīraḥ sahasvān vājī sahamāna ugraḥ / abhivīro abhisatvā sahojā jaitram indra ratham ā tiṣṭha govit //
analyzed: sthaviraḥ pravīraḥ sahasvān vājī sahamānaḥ ugraḥ abhivīraḥ abhisatvā sahaḥ jāḥ jaitram indra ratham ā tiṣṭha go vid

original: (4.6.4.2.g) abhi gotrāṇi sahasā gāhamāno 'dāyaḥ //(4.6.4.3) vīraḥ śatamanyur indraḥ / duścyavanaḥ pṛtanāṣāḍ ayudhyo 'smākaṁ senā avatu pra yutsu //
analyzed: abhi gotrāṇi sahasā gāhamānaḥ dāyaḥ vīraḥ śatamanyuḥ indraḥ duścyavanaḥ pṛtanāṣāh ayudhyaḥ smākaṁ senāḥ avatu pra yutsu

original: (4.6.4.3ḥ) indra āsāṃ netā bṛhaspatir dakṣiṇā yajñaḥ pura etu somaḥ / devasenānām abhibhañjatīnāṃ jayantīnām maruto yantv agre //
analyzed: indraḥ āsām netā bṛhaspatiḥ dakṣiṇā yajñaḥ puras etu somaḥ deva senānām abhibhañjatīnām jayantīnām marutaḥ yantu agre

original: (4.6.4.3.i) indrasya vṛṣṇo varuṇasya rājña ādityānām marutāṁ śardha ugram / mahāmanasām bhuvanacyavānāṃ ghoṣo devānāṃ jayatām ud asthāt //
analyzed: indrasya vṛṣṇaḥ varuṇasya rājñaḥ ādityānām marutām śardhaḥ ugram mahāmanasām bhuvanacyavānām ghoṣaḥ devānām jayatām ud asthāt

original: (4.6.4.3.k) asmākam indraḥ samṛteṣu dhvajeṣv asmākaṃ yā iṣavas tā jayantu //(4.6.4.4) asmākaṃ vīrā uttare bhavantv asmān u devā avatā haveṣu //
analyzed: asmākam indraḥ samṛteṣu dhvajeṣu asmākam yāḥ iṣavaḥ tāḥ jayantu asmākam vīrāḥ uttare bhavantu asmān u devāḥ avata haveṣu

original: (4.6.4.4ḷ) ud dharṣaya maghavann āyudhāny ut satvanām māmakānām mahāṁsi / ud vṛtrahan vājināṃ vājināny ud rathānāṃ jayatām etu ghoṣaḥ //
analyzed: ud dharṣaya maghavan āyudhāni ud satvanām māmakānām mahān asi ud vṛtrahan vājinām vājināni ud rathānām jayatām etu ghoṣaḥ

original: (4.6.4.4ṃ) upa preta jayatā nara sthirā vaḥ santu bāhavaḥ / indro vaḥ śarma yachatv anādhṛṣyā yathāsatha //
analyzed: upa preta jayata naraḥ sthirāḥ vaḥ santu bāhavaḥ indraḥ vaḥ śarma yacchatu anādhṛṣyāḥ yathā asatha

original: (4.6.4.4ṇ) avasṛṣṭā parā pata śaravye brahmasaṁśitā / gachāmitrān pra //(4.6.4.5) viśa maiṣāṃ kaṃ canoc chiṣaḥ //
analyzed: avasṛṣṭā parā pata śaravye brahma saṁśitā gaccha amitrān pra viśa mā eṣām kam cana ud śiṣaḥ

original: (4.6.4.5.o) marmāṇi te varmabhiś chādayāmi somas tvā rājāmṛtenābhi vastām / uror varīyo varivas te astu jayantaṃ tvām anu madantu devāḥ //
analyzed: marmāṇi te varmabhiḥ chādayāmi somaḥ tvā rājā amṛtena abhi vastām uroḥ varīyaḥ varivaḥ te astu jayantam tvām anu madantu devāḥ

original: (4.6.4.5.p) yatra bāṇāḥ sampatanti kumārā viśikhā iva / indro nas tatra vṛtrahā viśvāhā śarma yachatu //
analyzed: yatra bāṇāḥ sampatanti kumārāḥ viśikhāḥ iva indraḥ naḥ tatra vṛtrahā viśvāhā śarma yacchatu

original: (4.6.5.1.a) prācīm anu prādiśam prehi vidvān agner agne puroagnir bhaveha / viśvā āśā dīdyāno vi bhāhy ūrjaṃ no dhehi dvipade catuṣpade //

original: (4.6.5.1.b) kramadhvam agninā nākam ukhyaṁ hasteṣu bibhrataḥ / divaḥ pṛṣṭhaṁ suvar gatvā miśrā devebhir āddhvam //
analyzed: kramadhvam agninā nākam ukhyaṁ hasteṣu bibhrataḥ divaḥ pṛṣṭham suvar gatvā miśrāḥ devebhiḥ āddhvam

original: (4.6.5.1.c) pṛthivyā aham ud antarikṣam āruham antarikṣād divam āruham / divo nākasya pṛṣṭhāt suvar jyotir agām //(4.6.5.2) aham //
analyzed: pṛthivyāḥ aham ud antarikṣam āruham antarikṣāt divam āruham divaḥ nākasya pṛṣṭhāt suvar jyotiḥ agām aham

original: (4.6.5.2ḍ) suvar yanto nāpekṣanta ā dyāṁ rohanti rodasī / yajñaṃ ye viśvatodhāraṁ suvidvāṁso vitenire //
analyzed: suvar yantaḥ na apekṣante ā dyāṁ rohanti rodasī yajñam ye viśvatas dhāram su vidvāṁsaḥ vitenire

original: (4.6.5.2.e) agne prehi prathamo devayatāṃ cakṣur devānām uta martyānām / iyakṣamāṇā bhṛgubhiḥ sajoṣāḥ suvar yantu yajamānāḥ svasti //
analyzed: agne prehi prathamaḥ devayatām cakṣuḥ devānām uta martyānām iyakṣamāṇāḥ bhṛgubhiḥ sajoṣāḥ suvar yantu yajamānāḥ svasti

original: (4.6.5.2.f) naktoṣāsā samanasā virūpe dhāpayete śiśum ekaṁ samīcī / dyāvā kṣāmā rukmo antar vibhāti devā agniṃ dhārayan draviṇodāḥ //
analyzed: nakta uṣāsā samanasā virūpe dhāpayete śiśum ekaṁ samīcī dyāvā kṣāmā rukmaḥ antar vibhāti devāḥ agnim dhārayan draviṇaḥ dāḥ

original: (4.6.5.2.g) agne sahasrākṣa //(4.6.5.3) śatamūrdhañ chataṃ te prāṇāḥ sahasram apānāḥ / tvaṁ sāhasrasya rāya īśiṣe tasmai te vidhema vājāya svāhā //
analyzed: agne sahasra akṣa śata mūrdhan śatam te prāṇāḥ sahasram apānāḥ tvaṁ sāhasrasya rāyaḥ īśiṣe tasmai te vidhema vājāya svāhā

original: (4.6.5.3ḥ) suparṇo 'si garutmān pṛthivyāṁ sīda pṛṣṭhe pṛthivyāḥ sīda bhāsāntarikṣam ā pṛṇa jyotiṣā divam ut tabhāna tejasā diśa ud dṛṁha //
analyzed: suparṇaḥ si garutmān pṛthivyāṁ sīda pṛṣṭhe pṛthivyāḥ sīda bhāsā antarikṣam ā pṛṇa jyotiṣā divam ud tabhāna tejasā diśaḥ ud dṛṁha

original: (4.6.5.3.i) ājuhvānaḥ supratīkaḥ purastād agne svāṃ yonim ā sīda sādhyā / asmint sadhasthe adhy uttarasmin viśve devāḥ //(4.6.5.4) yajamānaś ca sīdata //
analyzed: ājuhvānaḥ su pratīkaḥ purastāt agne svām yonim ā sīda sādhyāḥ asmin sadhasthe adhi uttarasmin viśve devāḥ yajamānaḥ ca sīdata

original: (4.6.5.4.k) preddho agne dīdihi puro no 'jasrayā sūrmyā yaviṣṭha / tvāṁ śaśvanta upa yanti vājāḥ //
analyzed: preddhaḥ agne dīdihi puras naḥ jasrayā sūrmyā yaviṣṭha tvāṁ śaśvantaḥ upa yanti vājāḥ

original: (4.6.5.4ḷ) vidhema te parame janmann agne vidhema stomair avare sadhasthe / yasmād yoner udārithā yaje tam pra tve havīṁṣi juhure samiddhe //
analyzed: vidhema te parame janman agne vidhema stomaiḥ avare sadhasthe yasmāt yoneḥ udāritha yaje tam pra tve havīṁṣi juhure samiddhe

original: (4.6.5.4ṃ) tāṁ savitur vareṇyasya citrām āhaṃ vṛṇe sumatiṃ viśvajanyām / yām asya kaṇvo aduhat prapīnāṁ sahasradhārām //(4.6.5.5) payasā mahīṃ gām //
analyzed: tāṁ savituḥ vareṇyasya citrām ā aham vṛṇe sumatim viśvajanyām yām asya kaṇvaḥ aduhat prapīnāṁ sahasra dhārām payasā mahīm gām

original: (4.6.5.5ṇ) sapta te agne samidhaḥ sapta jihvāḥ saptarṣayaḥ sapta dhāma priyāṇi / sapta hotrāḥ saptadhā tvā yajanti sapta yonīr ā pṛṇasvā ghṛtena //
analyzed: sapta te agne samidhaḥ sapta jihvāḥ sapta ṛṣayaḥ sapta dhāma priyāṇi sapta hotrāḥ saptadhā tvā yajanti sapta yonīḥ ā pṛṇasva ghṛtena
